row.known_text: I'm going to try to explain what I mean.
I'd like to be able to speak after you finish.
row.target_text: بدي أقدر أحكي بعد ما تخلص.
row.target_text_roman: biddi a'dar ahki ba'd ma tkhlas.

row.known_text: And I want you to speak Arabic with me tomorrow.
row.target_text: وبدي ياك تحكي معي عربي بكرا.

row.known_text: He wants to come back with everyone else later on.
row.target_text: بدو يرجع مع كل الباقين بعدين.
row.target_text_roman: biddo yirja' ma' kull al-baa'iin ba'deen.

row.known_text: I'm going to start talking more soon.
I'm not going to be able to remember easily.
row.target_text: مش رح يكون بمقدوري أتذكر بسهولة.
row.target_text_roman: mish raH yikuun b-ma'duuri atadhakkar b-suhuule.

row.known_text: Are you going to help me before I have to go?
I like feeling as if I'm nearly ready to go.
row.target_text: بحب الإحساس إني تقريباً جاهز أروح.
row.target_text_roman: bHibb al-iHsaas inni ta'riiban jaahiz aruuH.

row.known_text: I'm looking forward to speaking better as soon as I can.
row.target_text: مشتاق أحكي أحسن بأسرع وقت ممكن.
row.target_text_roman: mushtaa' aHki aHsan bi-asra' wa't mumkin.

row.known_text: Did you want to show me something?
He doesn't want to be quiet when other people are here.
row.target_text: ما بدو يسكت لما يكون في ناس هون.
row.target_text_roman: ma bido yuskit lamma yikuun fii naas hoon.

row.known_text: How do you feel at the moment?
I feel okay, but I'm starting to feel tired.
row.target_text: حاسس تمام، بس عم ببدأ أحس بتعب.
row.target_text_roman: 7aasis tamaam, bas 3am bibd a' a7iss bi ta'ab.

row.known_text: I was starting to feel better than last night.
row.target_text: كنت عم ببدأ أحس أحسن من الليلة الماضية.
row.target_text_roman: kunt 'am bbda' ahiss ahsan min al-leele al-maadiye.

row.known_text: But I don't worry about making mistakes.
It's like this, if you know what I mean.
row.target_text: هيك هو الموضوع، إذا فاهم شو قصدي.
row.target_text_roman: hiik huwwe al-mawduu', idha faahim shu 'asdi.

row.known_text: He didn't want to look after the young dog all afternoon.
row.target_text: ما كان بدو يهتم بالكلب الصغير طول بعد الضهر.
row.target_text_roman: ma kaan biddo yihtamm bil-kalb al-zghiir tuul ba'd al-duhr.

row.known_text: We're friends, and after we finish I'd like to relax.
row.target_text: نحنا أصحاب، وبعد ما نخلص بدي أسترخي.
row.target_text_roman: nihna ashaab, wba'd maa nkhallas biddi astarkhii.

row.known_text: I think that's a good idea.
It's more important to talk often than to be perfect.
row.target_text: أهم تحكي كتير من تكون مثالي.

row.known_text: No problem. Everything is okay.
row.target_text: ما في مشكلة. كل شي تمام.
row.target_text_roman: ma fii mushkile. kull shi tamaam.

row.known_text: This isn't very difficult, so I hope you'll finish soon.
row.target_text: هيدا مش صعب كتير، فبتمنى تخلص قريباً.
row.target_text_roman: hayda mish sa'b ktiir, fa bitmanna tkhlas 'ariiban.

row.known_text: So I don't need to change.
Did you watch a bit of television?
I watched the football and then I watched a film.
row.target_text: تفرجت على الكرة وبعدين تفرجت على فيلم.

row.known_text: No I only had to do the most important job.
row.target_text: لا كان لازم بس أعمل الشغلة الأهم.
row.target_text_roman: la kaan laazim bass a'mal al-shaghleh al-ahamm.

row.known_text: No that's not a problem.
I wonder if he knows the answer.
She said that she doesn't want to live in a city.
row.target_text: قالت إنها ما بدها تسكن بالمدينة.

row.known_text: I think that he wants to sit down.
Yes he felt like talking a lot.
row.target_text: آه حس إنو بدو يحكي كتير.
row.target_text_roman: eh hass inno biddo yihki ktiir.

row.known_text: I saw several horses on the road.
I went to see a film on Wednesday.
row.target_text: رحت أتفرج على فيلم يوم الأربعاء.

row.known_text: That person you work with.
Do we need to get ready soon?
We would like to reserve a table for four tonight.
They could mean that they want you to ask.
Did they want to develop a new approach?
Yes they'll be happy to help.
Did they say who they saw last night?
It wasn't in front of the blue sign.
My grandfather fought in Italy during the war.
Next time I will ask her what her name is.
row.target_text: المرة الجاية رح أسألها شو اسمها.
row.target_text_roman: al-marra al-jaaye rah is'alha shu isma.

row.known_text: She has such a kind heart.
I think your eyes are beautiful.
She almost got lost because she turned left instead of right.
row.target_text: كادت تتيه لأنها لفت يسار بدل يمين.
row.target_text_roman: kaadit titiih la'annha laffit yasaar badal yamiin.

row.known_text: I couldn't imagine myself having exactly the same problem.
row.target_text: ما كنت أقدر أتخيل حالي عندي بالضبط نفس المشكلة.
row.target_text_roman: ma kunt a'dar itkhayyal haali 'indi bil-zabt nafs al-mushkile.

row.known_text: Because he has been playing in the mud.
I am feeling sad at the moment.
The church at the other end of the village is ugly.
I think the small church is very ugly.
And I'm too tired to fetch a new one.
row.target_text: وأنا كتير تعبان تا جيب واحدة جديدة.
row.target_text_roman: w-ana ktiir ta'baan ta jiib waahde jdiide.

row.known_text: They play music late at night.
I wish they wouldn't play such loud music.
row.target_text: يا ريت ما يعزفوا موسيقى بهالصوت الصاخب.
row.target_text_roman: ya reet ma ya'zfu muusii'a b-hal-soot al-saakhib.

row.known_text: It goes down to the beach
I don't care if it's a fast car.
row.target_text: ما بهمني إذا كانت السيارة سريعة.
row.target_text_roman: ma bihimmni iza kaanit al-sayyaara sarii'a.

row.known_text: I'm expecting to see an improvement next time we meet.
row.target_text: رح أتوقع أشوف تحسن المرة الجاية نلتقي.
row.target_text_roman: rah itwaqqa' shuuf tahassun al-marra al-jaaye nilta'i.

row.known_text: Have you decided how much you are willing to pay?
It's been upsetting.
I can see the mountains out of my bedroom window.
row.target_text: فيني أشوف الجبال من شباك أوضتي.
row.target_text_roman: fiini shuuf al-jbaal min shibbaak ooditi.

row.known_text: So I wanted to grow up and leave home.
row.target_text: هيك كنت بدي أكبر وأطلع من البيت.
row.target_text_roman: hiik kunt biddi ikbar w-itla' min al-beet.

row.known_text: She followed me down to the shops.
And along the main road.
I need to lie down in the garden.
We were talking about how it all started.
row.target_text: كنا عم نحكي كيف بدأ كل شي.
row.target_text_roman: kunna 'am nihki kiif bada' kull shi.

row.known_text: He needs to look for work.
We probably would have bought a house there.
row.target_text: على الأغلب كنا رح نشتري بيت هونيك.
row.target_text_roman: 'ala al-aghlab kunna rah nishtiri beet hooniik.

row.known_text: Do you want a cup of coffee or tea?
No, I'm not thirsty, thank you.
A large glass of water would be fine.
row.target_text: كاسة مي كبيرة رح تكون تمام.
row.target_text_roman: kaasit mayy kbiire rah tkuun tamaam.

row.known_text: That is Jane's bag.
I'm trying to think.
